recovery.required_count_context: prepare2d.verify_release then capacity_context2d.approved_capacity using exact staged release/capacity/source/FD1 inputs
recovery.volume_operation: primary_volume.PrimaryVolumeStore then primary_volume.materialize into fresh prepared/volume; byte-identical copy to restored_volume
recovery.verification: Every regenerated archive and semantic field hash plus complete original manifest; fail closed and retain discrepancies
recovery.cost: Record regeneration, verification, copying and dependency setup as offline costs; no online timing claim
recovery.runtime: Exact primary manifest runtime/source identity and retained dependency wheels/prefix; no native recovery executed here
